Supreme Court Orders Penalties for States Over Worsening Yamuna Pollution

The Supreme Court has directed the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) to levy penalties on states and Union Territories where pollution in the Yamuna river has worsened, despite significant spending on its cleaning. The court observed that despite huge sums spent, pollution has only increased. The court's order comes as a strong reprimand to the administrations responsible for the areas from where the Yamuna's water becomes polluted.
